Cortical/frontal/insular involvement is also compatible with an IDH-mutant diffuse glioma. Overall, the imaging metadata supports IDH-mutant status.

who_grade.reasoning: For grade estimation considered independently from molecular predictions, the lesion is entirely nonenhancing, has no enhancing component, no necrotic/nonenhancing core volume, and no imaging necrosis, which favors a lower-grade diffuse glioma imaging phenotype. A solitary lesion without satellite disease or ependymal invasion also argues against an overt high-grade glioma pattern. The main features arguing for a higher grade are the large FLAIR lesion volume, deep white-matter invasion, and measurable midline shift, which indicate substantial mass effect and infiltrative extent.
